race.comment: The 100K feature is the Wodonga Cup. BUCCLEUCH (1) has made plenty of plenty of progress this season, and just laboured as the favourite at Flemington last time out, finishing seventh. He might prefer some cut in the ground, but either way, he is right up to winning this. PRESSER (5) is a durable veteran racing well for in form trainer Gavin Bedggood, winning his last start at Mornington in a 100K race over this trip. Stick with him on all quaddie tickets. BULLETS HIGH (8) beat a handy type when taking out the Donald Cup 12 days ago, and he only carries an extra half-a-kilo in this. That win broke a drought, and with his confidence up, he can repeat the dose. BLACK STORM (7) is likely to roll forward early on here, and is nearing his peak fitness fourth up from a spell. Each way value. ITSUKUSHIMA (10) will be chasing a hat-trick of wins, and has won a jump-out since his last success at Bendigo a month ago. Keep safe.
